model: NKG2016LU_lev (levelled land uplift, relative to the GIA-rising geoid), mm/yr; values_abs = NKG2016LU_abs
note: Row-major, y ascending (row 0 = y0), x ascending within a row; node centres at x0+i*dx, y0+j*dy. Bilinear interpolation in lat/lon (ETRS89) of the native 1/12 deg x 1/6 deg NKG2016LU grids (Vestol et al. 2019, J Geod 93:1759, doi:10.1007/s00190-019-01280-8). lev = abs - geoid rise (NKG2016GIA_prel0306). Use 'values' (lev) for tilting of water surfaces. Standard uncertainty of the model here ~0.2-0.3 mm/yr (absolute); the SE-NW difference is far better determined than the absolute level because errors are spatially correlated.
